title: The MRP Corpus: A Speech Dataset of Modern Received Pronunciation
annotation_provenance: orthographic/phone processing mixed; phoneme sequences automatically generated; only one utterance per speaker manually checked for phone-label agreement
reason: Primary recordings are valid, but the relevant phone sequences are automatically generated and the paper reports only a 29-utterance manual spot-check, not exhaustive human correction. Therefore the corpus does not meet the current manually grounded phone/segment inclusion rule. Retain as excluded unless a separate fully corrected annotation layer is released.
